    <description>MIKE 1D Mike1DDataAccess

Mike1DDataAccess is the overall data access component, containing data for an entire simulation and from all other data access components.

MIKE 1D is a 1-dimensional numerical simulation engine that simulates water flow in a network.

NOTE: This package is 64-bit only. Please be sure to target x64 when building. For troubleshooting, visit the NuGet section on the Project Site/URL</description>
